svg.title: Pastry Pirates — V3 · The Round Table — Island shapes (9)
svg.desc: Every tetromino orientation: the seven footprints of the app plus the mirror images of the L and the S. Seven go out each voyage. The first version, shaped to your drawing: a gently wavy coast with 5 mm corners, a thin sand line 4 mm inside it, grass, a palm, a rock — and a plain 9 × 2.5 mm notch in the middle of every outside edge, between the cut and the line. Units: mm. 25 mm squares, 6 mm material. No kerf compensation in this file — it is a design view; cut from the sheet-N files. RASTER = black fill (engrave), CUT = red hairline (cut). Generated by physical-board/generate.mjs.
